Landslides Block Roads in Maharashtra and Jammu & Kashmir Due to Heavy Rain

Heavy rainfall has caused landslides on the Lonavala-Rajmachi route in Maharashtra and the Ramnagar-Udhampur road near Kaugha in Jammu & Kashmir. Rescue efforts and road clearance operations are underway in both locations. The incidents highlight the impact of severe weather on transportation infrastructure.
